column1: # Audited claim register for /rfc/full-demo/ — see the INV-1..INV-5 comment in tools/check_full_demo.py.
# Every sentence of the demo copy that NAMES a Phase A artefact must appear here, verbatim after whitespace
# normalisation, with a verdict. This file IS the audit: the checker guarantees that nothing naming an artefact
# ships unaudited and that each verdict is internally consistent, not that the verdict was reached correctly.
#   PENDING   the sentence makes no claim that a deferred Phase A step has been executed. This is the default and
#             the weaker verdict: it is true of normative RFC text, of deferral notes, and of statements about the
#             world outside this project. A PENDING sentence carrying completion language must carry a qualifier.
#   CAPTURED  the sentence states something that WAS executed for this capture, by the operator
#             (raincoatrun@gmail.com). The evidence column names the live/ or sql/ file that substantiates it, and
#             the sentence may not name a deferred artefact without a not-done marker.
# Format: verdict<TAB>evidence-or-dash<TAB>sentence. Regenerate by editing the copy, then re-auditing the diff.
